name: Summer Concurrent Enrollment (DMACC Career Advantage)
what_you_do: Take a real college class in the summer. Earn college credit while you are still in high school. Summer 2026 classes included anatomy and physiology, statistics, programming, medical terms and accounting.
grades: Current juniors and younger (rising seniors and below)
who_can_apply: High school students who are current juniors or younger. Graduating seniors cannot join. Priority goes to the classes of 2027 and 2028. Classes with prerequisites need those finished first.
pay_detail: No cost to the student. Books and supplies are provided before the first day of class.
duration: Courses run from late May through early August. In 2026 they ran from May 26 to August 5.
deadline_text: The 2026 pre-registration form is closed. The program page lists no deadline for future summers.
how_to_apply: Fill out a pre-registration form for each class. You can take up to two classes. Seats depend on space and placement is not promised. For classes at Central Campus or Valley High School, do not send the form. Contact the Coordinator for that program.
notes: Campuses listed for 2026 were Ames, Ankeny, Perry, Des Moines (Urban), West Des Moines, and online. Students are expected to attend when the class begins. Call (800) 362-2127 with questions.
